set.body:
Objective

Specify the universal effect-form contract before production refactoring.

Primary ownership

Architecture/design documentation and independent law fixtures. This item must not change public numerical behavior.

Decisions to freeze

- Ordered left_space and right_space identity and axis alignment.
- Rectangular vectorization order and the symmetric packed specialization.
- Meaning of self_form, symmetric, and guaranteed_psd capabilities.
- Ordered partition-edge semantics, including how cross_partitions() recovers the existing self-adjoint estimator.
- Bridge compatibility and identity.
- Canonical operation order: partition-pair product -> spatial normalization -> edge transform -> partition reduction -> pair query.
- Weighted covariance convention, correlation zero-variance policy, Fisher boundary policy, and complete-form versus query-only semantics.
- Scientific-plan and receipt identity fields.
- Public compatibility and deprecation policy.

Acceptance

Independent fixtures state and test self-specialization, transpose, direct-sum, packed/rectangular, linear-fusion, final-query baseline-invariance, centered-sufficient-statistic, bridge, and no-bridge laws. Negative fixtures demonstrate normalization/Fisher noncommutation and covariate-weighted Q losing column balance. Every later child can cite an unambiguous contract.

Non-goals

No production kernel, storage, or public API migration in this item.
set.title: Freeze effect-form semantics and executable algebraic laws
